description: REQUIRES prior fourinsure__session__login call with same account_link_id. Submit a 4대보험 certificate application. IRREVERSIBLE: the application is filed with the 정보연계센터 and a receipt number is assigned; there is no cancel action. Call without confirm first to get a preview, show it to the user, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

confirm_submit.description: Dry-run selector, NOT the consent gate (that is `confirm`). false validates the payload without submitting. Default true.

dry_run.description: true returns the prepared payload without submitting. Default false.

selection.description: Certificate selection key from apply.init ('3'=사업장 가입자 명부, else 사업장 가입내역 확인서)

name: fourinsure__b1__certificate__apply__submit
title: 4대보험 증명서 신청 제출
